name: ipv4-catch-all-excluded-invalid
description: An IPv4 excluded subtree of 0.0.0.0/0 matches every IPv4 address. The leaf has an IPv4 SAN, so it falls inside the excluded subtree and the chain must be rejected. This catches implementations that treat an all-zero mask as an empty or no-op IP constraint.
notes: Zero-length prefixes are legal CIDR ranges. They are easy to mishandle if IP constraints are represented as masked prefixes and code special-cases an all-zero mask as absent state.
